scams.name: Digital arrest scam
steps: Caller poses as police, CBI, NCB, RBI or customs and says your name is in a crime
You are kept on a video call and told not to tell anyone
You are pushed to transfer money to 'verify' or 'settle' the case
flags: Video call with uniformed people or fake police station background
Threat of immediate arrest over phone or video
Demand to stay on call and keep it secret
Request to move money to a 'safe' or 'verification' account
todo: Call 1930, the National Cyber Crime Helpline, as early as possible
Report the complaint on cybercrime.gov.in
Disconnect the call; there is no 'digital arrest' procedure, so verify with your local police station
Inform your bank and ask them to block the card, account or UPI
Report the fraud call or SMS on Chakshu at sancharsaathi.gov.in
Preserve evidence: screenshots, numbers, links, UTR or transaction IDs
Do not pay anything more, whatever the caller says

Pressure, threats and urgency
todo: Call 1930, the National Cyber Crime Helpline, as early as possible
Report the complaint on cybercrime.gov.in
Check directly with the courier company using its official website number
Report the fraud call or SMS on Chakshu at sancharsaathi.gov.in
Preserve evidence: screenshots, numbers, links, UTR or transaction IDs
Do not pay anything more, whatever the caller says

scams.name: UPI collect request fraud
scams.hinglish: UPI collect request se paisa kat jaana
steps: Fraudster, often posing as a buyer or helper, sends a UPI collect request
The message says enter your UPI PIN to receive money
Entering the PIN approves a payment out of your account
flags: Being told to enter PIN to receive money
Unknown collect request after a call or chat
Urgent push to approve quickly
Request labelled as refund or prize
todo: Call 1930, the National Cyber Crime Helpline, as early as possible
Report the complaint on cybercrime.gov.in
Inform your bank and ask them to block the card, account or UPI
Remember: UPI PIN is only needed to send money, never to receive
Preserve evidence: screenshots, numbers, links, UTR or transaction IDs

scams.name: Sextortion video call
steps: An attractive fake profile befriends you on social media and starts a video call
The call is screen recorded, and the recording is used to blackmail you
You are threatened that the video will be sent to family and friends unless you pay
flags: Stranger quickly moves to a video call
Sexual content within minutes of chatting
Threats to share a recording with your contacts
Repeated demands for money, sometimes followed by calls from people posing as police or officials
todo: Call 1930, the National Cyber Crime Helpline, as early as possible
Report the complaint on cybercrime.gov.in
Do not pay or give in to threats
First save screenshots of the profile, chats and numbers, then report the profile to the platform and block it
Preserve evidence: screenshots, numbers, links, UTR or transaction IDs
Report the call or number on Chakshu at sancharsaathi.gov.in within 30 days. If you already lost money, use 1930 or cybercrime.gov.in
You can also file a complaint at your nearest police station with the screenshots and payment proof
Talk to family or a trusted person; you are the victim

Report the complaint on cybercrime.gov.in

Inform your bank and ask them to block the card, account or UPI

scams.name: Illegal loan app harassment
steps: An app promises quick and hassle free loans
It asks for access to your contacts, photos and files, and charges very high interest and hidden fees
Recovery agents use harsh, high handed methods to harass borrowers
MeitY has blocked 87 illegal loan apps under IT Act s.69A (PIB, 21 Jul 2026)
flags: The app does not name the bank or NBFC behind the loan, or is not listed in RBI's directory of Digital Lending Apps (being listed is not an RBI endorsement)
App asks for contacts, gallery and storage access
Very high interest and hidden charges
Threats, abuse or harassment during recovery
todo: Call 1930, the National Cyber Crime Helpline, as early as possible
Report the complaint on cybercrime.gov.in
Do not pay threats or extra demands. Check the lender's name and look the app up in RBI's directory of Digital Lending Apps (Citizen's Corner on rbi.org.in)
If the loan is from a bank or NBFC, complain to the lender first; if there is no reply in 30 days or you are unhappy, complain to the RBI Ombudsman at cms.rbi.org.in
Preserve evidence: screenshots, numbers, links, UTR or transaction IDs
Report the app to the app store
If your contacts get threatening messages, tell them not to respond and to share screenshots with you
law: IT Act s.67 (if obscene morphed images are sent)

scams.name: AI voice clone or deepfake emergency call
scams.hinglish: AI awaaz copy karke emergency call
steps: Fraudsters use AI tools to copy a voice or face from online videos or calls
You get a call that sounds like a family member in trouble
You are pushed to send money urgently
flags: Urgent emergency with pressure to pay now
Voice sounds robotic or flat, or on video the lips do not match the words
Payment to an unknown UPI or account
The call often comes from a number you do not have saved, but a known number can also be spoofed or hacked
todo: Call 1930, the National Cyber Crime Helpline, as early as possible
Report the complaint on cybercrime.gov.in
Hang up and call the person back on their known number
Inform your bank and ask them to block the card, account or UPI
Report the suspected fraud call on Chakshu at sancharsaathi.gov.in within 30 days. If you already lost money, call 1930 or file on cybercrime.gov.in first
Preserve evidence: screenshots, numbers, links, UTR or transaction IDs
Do not pay anything more, whatever the caller says
Limit public videos and voice notes of yourself and family; a short clip can be enough to copy a voice
